name: Aozora Ikaru
source:
Occupation：Gravure Idol

Subject: English (conversation)

Personality: The seventh daughter of the Aozora sisters. She talks to the main character as if he were a friend. She is very serious about her work, and will even show the protagonist bold poses if it's for help.
